source_workflow.name: Daily e-commerce pipeline
source_workflow.purpose: Make a revenue dashboard ready from two independent source feeds.

tasks.name: extract_orders
tasks.purpose: Bring today’s order data into the pipeline.

tasks.name: extract_customers
tasks.purpose: Bring customer data into the pipeline independently of orders.

tasks.name: stg_orders
tasks.purpose: Run the declared orders staging model.

tasks.name: stg_customers
tasks.purpose: Run the declared customer staging model.

tasks.name: int_orders
tasks.purpose: Wait for both staging models, then run the declared intermediate model.

tasks.name: quality_check
tasks.purpose: Execute the supplied order quality check before the fact is published.

tasks.name: fct_orders
tasks.purpose: Publish the declared order fact only after the model and quality check finish.

tasks.name: mart_revenue
tasks.purpose: Publish the declared revenue mart for this partition.

tasks.name: dashboard
tasks.purpose: Refresh the executive dashboard from the published mart.
